RIP Nozomi ❤️

Download Nozomi

On Windows, run NozomiLauncher to install and update the game clients.

Download for Windows

Studio for Windows

Download Studio ZIP
  1. Extract the ZIP into its own folder.
  2. Open NozomiStudioBeta.exe and sign in.
  3. For updates, download the latest ZIP and extract it into a new folder. Keep your saved projects.

Studio updates are manual. NozomiLauncher only handles game clients.

Android

Get the launcher. It downloads the available 2018 client when you open it.

Download Android launcher
  1. Open the downloaded APK on your Android device.
  2. Allow installation from your browser if Android asks.
  3. Open Nozomi Launcher and confirm the 2018 client installation.
  4. Choose 2018 and tap Start.

May not work on some devices.

iOS

Choose a version, then download the IPA.

Download Nozomi 2018 for iOS
  1. Download the Nozomi 2018 IPA.
  2. Choose an installer below. AltStore and SideStore need a computer for the first setup.
  3. Import the IPA into your installer, then follow its signing and install prompts.
  4. Open Nozomi from your Home Screen.

Installers: AltStore Classic or SideStore (PC for setup); Sideloadly (PC). Signulous (paid, iPhone only); TrollStore (supported older iOS only).
